high_level_description: The image shows two views of a banknote, specifically the front and back sides of what appears to be a 100-unit currency note from the New Development Bank (NDB). The NDB is an international financial institution established by BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) to provide development finance for infrastructure projects. Design Elements: The front side features a circular emblem at the center, which includes the flags of several countries. These flags represent the member countries of the NDB: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Indonesia, Iran, Argentina,
